text_blocks.snippet: For vaccinated individuals, COVID-19 symptoms tend to be milder and shorter in duration compared to unvaccinated individuals. Common symptoms include fever, fatigue, sore throat, and dry cough, which may last for a few days. Some vaccinated people may also experience a loss of taste or smell, which can linger for a couple of weeks.

list.title: Severity and Duration:

list.title: Potential for More Severe Illness:
